violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cut honeydew and cantaloupe (47F), granola parfait (45F) in left self serve cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items relocated to alternative cold holding unit.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: observed left self serve cooler near entrance/register at 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC relocated TCS foods placed in unit to alternative, working cold holding unit to be cooled back down to 41F or below within a remainder of 2 hours. Facility will discontinue use of unit to store TCS items until repair is completed.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed right faucet at 3 compartment sink in kitchen unable to dispense water when turned on.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Please repair faucet at 3 compartment sink by next routine inspection. Facility has a second 3 compartment sink in basement to use in the meantime.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the hand sinks at the main kitchen being used to store a cambro container storing cut leafy greens, bread knife.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Employee removed items from hand sinks. Please ensure hand sinks are unblocked at all times for hand washing.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no paper towels at hand sink in kitchen and upstairs bar.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels at hand sinks.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed sausage patties (131-132F) in steam well at kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Employee reheated sausage to 165F+.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed single service cup used as scoop to dispense cut melon in main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed cup used as scoop and replaced with scoop with handle.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed dish machine in basement with no sanitizer solution.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC will contact dish repair technician and submit invoice to EHS within 10 days.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Observed no quaternary ammonia test kit in facility.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. Please order test strips and submit invoice to EHS within 10 days. NORTHSIDE SOCIAL FALLS CHURCH (Inspection Date: 11/10/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed drinking on cook line and throughout bakery in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Uncovered beverages observed throughout kitchen in areas where they may contaminate food or food contact surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. PIC removed all uncovered drinks from cook line and trained all staff on proper locations for employees to eat and drink.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked sausage patty (94F) in steam well on cook line of upstairs kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC reheated sausage patty to 165F.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: bowls without handles and scoops with handles in contact with dry goods observed in potato starch and sesame seed working containers.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed handles from contact with dry goods and discarded any food items that may have been contaminated by improper storage of in use utensils.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Spoons were found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward at self service station.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. PIC properly cleaned all spoons that may have been contaminated and placed all utensils with the lip contact surfaces protected from handling. NORTHSIDE SOCIAL FALLS CHURCH (Inspection Date: 05/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): storage of clean pots and pans off of the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. PIC placed all clean pots and pans in designated upraised storage and removed milk crates.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: single rack dish machine upstairs and single rack dish machine downstairs unable to reach chlorine bleach sanitizer concentration above 10 ppm
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC contacted technician during inspection and will provide verification of repair to EHS once completed. PIC prepared the three compartment sink with adequate quaternary ammonia concentration to sanitize all equipment until the repair of both dish machines.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed drinking in upstairs kitchen where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. PIC trained staff on designated locations where eating and drinking shall be conducted.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Raw yellowfin tuna stored in sealed vacuum sealed packaging observed thawing in 3 door prep unit (L) in upstairs kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: PIC removed raw tuna from sealed bags.
